name: rql-query
title: Query / Read
blurb: Read and change many objects with one query.
label: Read
summary: Read anything in the open scenes, prefabs, assets, console and project with one pipeline query.
description: Read anything in the open scenes, prefabs, assets, console and project with one pipeline query (`objects | where Light.intensity > 1 | select name, $path`). Filters, projects, sorts, groups and counts many objects in one call and answers as a compact text table. Use 'rql-schema' for the syntax and a type's members, 'rql-mutate' to change things.

name: rql-schema
title: Query / Schema
blurb: Read and change many objects with one query.
label: Schema
summary: Syntax card of the query language plus the component types present in the open scenes; with typeName, the members and methods of that type.
description: Syntax card of the query language plus the component types present in the open scenes; with `typeName`, the members (type, read or write) and methods of that type. Call it before writing a 'rql-query' or 'rql-mutate' query you are unsure of.

name: rql-mutate
title: Query / Change
blurb: Read and change many objects with one query.
label: Change
summary: Change many objects, components and assets in one query: objects | where name startswith "Enemy" | set Rigidbody.mass = 2.
description: Change many objects, components and assets in one query: `objects | where name startswith "Enemy" | set Rigidbody.mass = 2`. Also `call` methods, `add` components, `destroy` objects and create them with `new(...)`. All-or-nothing, one undo step, optional dry run.

name: scene-open
title: Scene / Open
blurb: Open, save and switch scenes.
label: Open
summary: Open a scene asset in Single or Additive mode without losing unsaved work in the scenes already open.
description: Open a scene asset in Single or Additive mode without losing unsaved work in the scenes already open. Returns the opened-scene list.

name: scene-save
title: Scene / Save
blurb: Open, save and switch scenes.
label: Save
summary: Save the active scene, one open scene, or every open scene with changes.
description: Save the active scene, one open scene, or every open scene with changes. A `path` on a saved scene writes a copy and leaves the open scene on its own file.

name: physics-query
title: Physics / Query
blurb: Find, create and edit objects in the open scene.
label: Physics / Query
summary: Raycast, spherecast, boxcast and sphere or box overlap against the colliders of the open scenes, in Edit mode, with no Play needed.
description: Raycast, spherecast, boxcast and sphere or box overlap against the colliders of the open scenes, in Edit mode, with no Play needed.

name: physics-simulate
title: Physics / Simulate
blurb: Find, create and edit objects in the open scene.
label: Physics / Simulate
summary: Run N physics steps on the open scenes in Edit mode and report which Rigidbodies moved, then put everything back.
description: Run N physics steps on the open scenes in Edit mode and report which Rigidbodies moved, then put everything back (or keep the result with undo).

name: assets-find-built-in
title: Assets / Find (Built-in)
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Find (Built-in)
summary: Search the built-in assets of the Unity Editor.
description: Search the built-in assets of the Unity Editor (located at Resources/unity_builtin_extra). Filters by name and/or type; built-in assets have no GUID so GUID-based lookups are not supported.

name: assets-shader-get-data
title: Assets / Shader / Get Data
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Shader / Get Data
summary: Get detailed data about a shader asset.
description: Get detailed data about a shader asset — properties, subshaders, passes, compilation messages, and supported status. Supports token-saving path-scoped reads via `paths` or `viewQuery`. Use 'rql-query' with `t:Shader` to locate the shader first.

name: assets-refresh
title: Assets / Refresh
blurb: Search, read and edit files in the project.
label: Refresh
summary: Refresh the Unity AssetDatabase.
description: Refresh the Unity AssetDatabase. Use after files were added or updated outside of the Unity API, or to force script recompilation when a '.cs' file changed. Returns a processing/success response and waits for compilation when triggered.

name: tests-result
title: Tests / Result
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Tests / Result
summary: Status and result of the last 'tests-run'.
description: Status and result of the last 'tests-run' (job id, state, summary, failures). Poll it after 'tests-run' with async=true, or fetch a result the client timed out on. The record is kept in Library and survives domain reloads.

name: script-execute
title: Script / Execute
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Script / Execute
summary: Compiles and executes C# code dynamically using Roslyn.
description: Compiles and executes C# code dynamically using Roslyn. Supports a full-code mode (default) and a body-only mode — see the skill body for the difference and for how to pass Unity object references as parameters.

name: tests-run
title: Tests / Run
blurb: Read and write scripts, run C#, run tests.
label: Tests / Run
summary: Execute Unity tests and return per-test results.
description: Execute Unity tests (`EditMode` or `PlayMode`) and return per-test results. Supports filtering by test assembly, namespace, class, and method. Refreshes the AssetDatabase first; defers execution across domain reloads if scripts changed. Precondition: every open scene must be saved — dirty scenes abort the run. action=list lists tests, action=clear frees a stuck run slot.

name: screenshot-editor-window
title: Screenshot / Editor Window
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Editor Window
summary: Capture any open Unity Editor window as the Editor draws it; the way to capture the Scene View as the user sees it.
description: Capture any open Unity Editor window (Inspector, Console, a custom tool window, a floating window) as the Editor draws it; the way to capture the Scene View as the user sees it (`window=SceneView`). Pick it by title or type name; default is the focused window. Scaled to `maxResolution` (default 1024; 0 = full size).

name: screenshot-game-view
title: Screenshot / Game View
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Game View
summary: Capture a screenshot of the Unity Editor's Game View, or of any Camera when cameraRef is given, and return it as a PNG for direct inspection.
description: Capture a screenshot of the Unity Editor's Game View, or of any Camera when `cameraRef` is given, and return it as a PNG for direct inspection. Optionally also saves the PNG inside the project. Scaled to `maxResolution` (default 1024; 0 = full size). For the Scene View as the user sees it use 'screenshot-editor-window' with window=SceneView.

name: screenshot-isolated
title: Screenshot / Isolated GameObject
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: Screenshot / Isolated GameObject
summary: Render a target GameObject from a chosen camera angle with optional layer-based isolation, configurable background, multi-light setup via JSON, Com...
description: Render a target GameObject from a chosen camera angle with optional layer-based isolation, configurable background (solid/skybox/transparent), multi-light setup via JSON, Composite (2x2 Front/Right/Back/Top) and Surround (3x2, all six sides) modes. Returns a PNG image. When isolated=true, inactive children may briefly fire OnEnable — see the body for side-effect notes.

name: ui-inspect-element
title: UI / Inspect Element
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Element
summary: Full DevTools-style detail of one visual element in an open EditorWindow: rects, measured text size, resolved styles, detected layout issues, ances...
description: Full DevTools-style detail of one visual element in an open EditorWindow: rects, measured text size, resolved styles (flex, size, margin/padding, overflow, whiteSpace, fontSize…), detected layout issues, ancestor chain, children, and the style sheets in scope for USS source mapping.

name: ui-inspect-tree
title: UI / Inspect Tree
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Tree
summary: Dump the UI Toolkit element tree of an open EditorWindow as indented text.
description: Dump the UI Toolkit element tree of an open EditorWindow as indented text — one line per element with index path, type, #name, .classes, world rect, text preview, and inline layout-issue flags (TEXT-CLIPPED, OVERFLOWS-PARENT, ZERO-SIZE). With an empty `windowName` it lists the open windows; with `onlyIssues` it returns just the layout problems. The DOM-inspector replacement for screenshots.

name: uitoolkit-render
title: UI Toolkit / Render
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI Toolkit / Render
summary: Render a UIDocument, a .uxml asset or a PanelSettings asset to a PNG at a chosen size, in Edit mode, without Game View or play mode.
description: Render a UIDocument (scene object path), a .uxml asset or a PanelSettings asset to a PNG at a chosen size, in Edit mode, without Game View or play mode. Leaves scenes and assets as they were.

name: ui-inspect-pick
title: UI / Inspect Pick
blurb: Screenshots and UI Toolkit inspection.
label: UI / Inspect Pick
summary: Interactive element picker, like the web DevTools inspect cursor: activates pick mode on an open EditorWindow, the user hovers and clicks the misbe...
description: Interactive element picker, like the web DevTools inspect cursor: activates pick mode on an open EditorWindow, the user hovers (live highlight) and clicks the misbehaving element, and the tool returns that element's full detail (index path, styles, detected issues) via the deferred requestId result.

name: editor-application-get-state
title: Editor / Application / Get State
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Application / Get State
summary: Return the current state of UnityEditor.EditorApplication.
description: Return the current state of `UnityEditor.EditorApplication` — playmode, paused state, compilation state, and related flags.

name: console-get-logs
title: Console / Get Logs
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Console / Get Logs
summary: Retrieve Unity Editor logs from the MCP plugin's LogCollector, optionally filtered by log type or time window.
description: Retrieve Unity Editor logs from the MCP plugin's `LogCollector`, optionally filtered by log type or time window. Useful for debugging and monitoring Editor activity.

name: editor-application-set-state
title: Editor / Application / Set State
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Application / Set State
summary: Enter, leave or pause play mode.
description: Enter, leave or pause play mode. Answers once the editor has reached the new state, domain reload included. Refuses to enter play mode while the project has compile errors.

name: settings-tags
title: Settings / Tags and Layers
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Settings / Tags and Layers
summary: List, add and remove tags, user layers and sorting layers of the project, with undo.
description: List, add and remove tags, user layers (8-31) and sorting layers of the project, with undo.

name: editor-undo
title: Editor / Undo
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Undo
summary: Undo or redo the last Editor undo groups and name each group.
description: Undo or redo the last Editor undo groups (like Edit > Undo / Redo) and name each group. Pairs with rql-mutate and scene edits that record Undo.

name: watch
title: Editor / Watch Playtest
blurb: Play mode, selection and the console.
label: Watch Playtest
summary: Learn a playtest workflow by watching the user play it, then replay it fast: watch start puts a cyan frame on the Game View and records every input...
description: Learn a playtest workflow by watching the user play it, then replay it fast: `watch start` puts a cyan frame on the Game View and records every input, UI click (object path, label, listeners), player position, scene change, console error and a frame every 2 s until the user exits Play mode or presses STOP; the user then describes the workflow in chat. Holds the read-ask-playbook-replay loop: read summary.md and contact sheets, read the code behind the clicks, ask only what is missing, write a playbook, replay with code shortcuts, UI clicks, walking and teleports only for long distances, and report stuck or fallen players. Use when the user invokes matrix-watch or asks to record, show, teach or replay a playtest flow.

name: package-search
title: Package Manager / Search
blurb: Search, install and remove packages.
label: Package Manager / Search
summary: Search Unity's package registry plus locally installed packages by query string, or list the installed packages.
description: Search Unity's package registry plus locally installed packages by query string, or list the installed packages (installedOnly=true). Returns available versions and installation status. Online mode fetches exact matches from the live registry then supplements with cached substring matches.

name: package-add
title: Package Manager / Add
blurb: Search, install and remove packages.
label: Package Manager / Add
summary: Install a Unity package from the registry, a Git URL, or a local path.
description: Install a Unity package from the registry, a Git URL, or a local path. Modifies `manifest.json` and triggers package resolution; may also trigger a domain reload — the final result is delivered after the reload via the request's `requestId`. Use 'package-search' for discovery first.

name: package-remove
title: Package Manager / Remove
blurb: Search, install and remove packages.
label: Package Manager / Remove
summary: Uninstall a UPM package from the Unity project.
description: Uninstall a UPM package from the Unity project. Modifies `manifest.json` and may trigger a domain reload — the final result is delivered after the reload via the request's `requestId`. Built-in packages and packages that are dependencies of others cannot be removed. Removing a package whose API is used by project code breaks compilation — check usages with 'package-search' with installedOnly=true (and search the codebase) first.

name: profiler-frame-debugger
title: Profiler / Frame debugger
blurb: Capture frames and read performance data.
label: Frame debugger
summary: Capture the rendering events of the current frame with the Frame Debugger: action=enable, events, disable, status.
description: Capture the rendering events (draw calls, clears, blits) of the current frame with the Frame Debugger: action=enable, events (index, type and name), disable, status.

name: profiler-memory
title: Profiler / Memory
blurb: Capture frames and read performance data.
label: Memory
summary: Named memory snapshots: take, list, delete, or compare two.
description: Named memory snapshots: take, list, delete, or compare two. A light snapshot (default) stores the memory counters and the loaded UnityEngine.Object count and size per type as JSON; mode=full also writes a native .snap file for the Memory Profiler package.

name: profiler-stats
title: Profiler / Stats
blurb: Capture frames and read performance data.
label: Stats
summary: One compact report of the profiler state, frame timing, memory counters and the Editor's rendering counters.
description: One compact report of the profiler state, frame timing, memory counters and the Editor's rendering counters. Optionally turns the runtime profiler on or off.

name: rendering-volume-get
title: Rendering / Volume Get
blurb: Lighting, Volumes and render pipeline.
label: Volume Get
summary: List the Volumes of the open scenes, or read the overrides of one Volume or Volume Profile asset: every component with its parameters and whether e...
description: List the Volumes of the open scenes, or read the overrides of one Volume (scene object path) or Volume Profile asset: every component with its parameters and whether each is overridden. Works with URP/HDRP post-processing and any pipeline that uses Volumes.

name: lighting-bake
title: Lighting / Bake
blurb: Lighting, Volumes and render pipeline.
label: Lighting / Bake
summary: Start, poll, cancel or clear the lightmap bake of the active scene.
description: Start, poll, cancel or clear the lightmap bake of the active scene. 'start' returns at once; poll with action='status' (state running with progress and retry_after_ms, or idle with the lightmap count). The bake survives a domain reload.

name: rendering-volume-set
title: Rendering / Volume Set
blurb: Lighting, Volumes and render pipeline.
label: Volume Set
summary: Set one Volume override: component, parameter, value and override state, on a scene Volume or a Volume Profile asset.
description: Set one Volume override: component (e.g. 'Bloom'), parameter (e.g. 'intensity'), value and override state, on a scene Volume or a Volume Profile asset. Adds the component when missing. One undo step. Use 'rendering-volume-get' to see the names.

name: animation-clip-get
title: Animation / Clip Get
blurb: Create clips, curves and animator controllers.
label: Clip Get
summary: Read an AnimationClip: length, frame rate, loop, every curve and events.
description: Read an AnimationClip: length, frame rate, loop, every curve (target path, component, property, keys) and events.

name: animation-controller-get
title: Animation / Controller Get
blurb: Create clips, curves and animator controllers.
label: Controller Get
summary: Read an AnimatorController: parameters, layers, states, transitions, blend trees.
description: Read an AnimatorController: parameters, layers, states (motion, speed), transitions (conditions, exit time, duration), blend trees.

name: animation-clip-set-curve
title: Animation / Clip Set Curve
blurb: Create clips, curves and animator controllers.
label: Clip Set Curve
summary: Set or remove one float property curve of an AnimationClip from {time, value} keys.
description: Set or remove one float property curve of an AnimationClip from {time, value} keys (smooth, linear or constant). Creates the .anim when it does not exist.

name: animation-controller-edit
title: Animation / Controller Edit
blurb: Create clips, curves and animator controllers.
label: Controller Edit
summary: Edit an AnimatorController with an ordered list of operations: parameters, layers, states, transitions with conditions, blend trees.
description: Edit an AnimatorController with an ordered list of operations: parameters, layers, states, transitions with conditions, blend trees.

name: build-status
title: Build / Status
blurb: Build the player as a background job.
label: Status
summary: State and result of the last 'build-start'.
description: State and result of the last 'build-start' (job id, state, output, errors and warnings with messages). Poll after 'build-start'.

name: build-cancel
title: Build / Cancel
blurb: Build the player as a background job.
label: Cancel
summary: Cancel the running or queued build job.
description: Cancel the running or queued build job. A queued job never starts; a running build stops at the next scene it processes.

name: build-start
title: Build / Start
blurb: Build the player as a background job.
label: Start
summary: Build a player from an explicit scene list into an output path for a target.
description: Build a player from an explicit scene list into an output path (default: the Build Settings scenes into Builds/<target>/, never inside Assets) for a target (default: the active build target). Starts a job and returns at once: poll 'build-status'. The Editor is busy until the build ends.

name: unity-tool-list
title: Tool / List
blurb: Let agents manage their own skills.
label: Tool / List
summary: List all Feeder MCP tools registered in the connected Unity Editor instance, including disabled ones; only a core set is on by default, so use this...
description: List all Feeder MCP tools registered in the connected Unity Editor instance, including disabled ones (see `enabled`); only a core set is on by default, so use this to find a tool, then enable it with tool-set-enabled-state. Optional regex filter matches against tool name, description, and argument names/descriptions. Use the `includeDescription` / `includeInputs` toggles to control the response size.

name: tool-set-enabled-state
title: Tool / Set Enabled State
blurb: Let agents manage their own skills.
label: Tool / Set Enabled State
summary: Enable or disable MCP tools by name in batch.
description: Enable or disable MCP tools by name in batch. Persists the change via `MatrixPluginEditor.Instance.Save()` only when at least one tool actually flipped. Returns per-input success flags plus optional operation logs.

name: hyper-testing
title: Hyper Testing / Clone Pool (Experimental)
label: Clone Pool (Experimental)
summary: EXPERIMENTAL.
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Manage the Hyper Testing clone pool for parallel play testing: status, up, refresh, down, ram. Works only after the user enabled Hyper Testing Mode by hand; agents can never enable it. Read the matrix-hyper-testing-guide skill first.

name: menu-execute
title: Menu / Execute
label: Execute
summary: Run an Editor menu item by its path, or list the menu paths that contain a text.
description: Run an Editor menu item by its path (for example 'Assets/Refresh' or 'Window/General/Console'), or list the menu paths that contain a text. Fails with a clear error when the path does not exist or the item is disabled.

name: serialized-get
title: Serialized / Get
label: Get
summary: Read the serialized properties of an asset or a project settings area as property paths, types and values, including private [SerializeField] field...
description: Read the serialized properties of an asset (ScriptableObject or any asset) or a project settings area as property paths, types and values, including private [SerializeField] fields and array sizes.

name: serialized-set
title: Serialized / Set
label: Set
summary: Set properties of an asset or a project settings area by SerializedProperty path, optionally creating a ScriptableObject asset first.
description: Set properties of an asset or a project settings area by SerializedProperty path (private fields and array resize 'items.Array.size=3' included), optionally creating a ScriptableObject asset first. Undo recorded.

name: vfx-preview
title: VFX / Preview
label: Preview
summary: Deterministic preview of a VFX prefab: text stats and one labelled contact-sheet PNG of N time samples from a fixed camera.
description: Deterministic preview of a VFX prefab: text stats (alive counts over time, per-emitter windows, fill/overdraw, warnings) and one labelled contact-sheet PNG of N time samples from a fixed camera.

name: vfx-read
title: VFX / Read spec
label: Read spec
summary: Read a VFX prefab asset or a scene object as compact JSON: only values that differ from the baseline emitter.
description: Read a VFX prefab asset (`path`) or a scene object (`target`) as compact JSON: only values that differ from the baseline emitter. Use it to see manual Inspector edits before patching.

name: vfx-apply
title: VFX / Apply spec
label: Apply spec
summary: Create or patch a ParticleSystem VFX from a compact JSON spec, on a prefab asset or a scene object.
description: Create or patch a ParticleSystem VFX from a compact JSON spec (emitters addressed by name, only changed fields), on a prefab asset (`path`) or a scene object (`target`). A prefab save stores a history version and returns text stats, optionally a time-lapse contact sheet.

name: vfx-history
title: VFX / History
label: History
summary: List, score or restore saved versions of a VFX prefab.
description: List, score or restore saved versions of a VFX prefab. Every vfx-apply stores one; manual Inspector edits are captured before the next apply.

name: vfx-texture
title: VFX / Texture
label: Texture
summary: Generate procedural particle textures into Assets/VFX/_Textures, or list existing ones with their recipes.
description: Generate procedural particle textures (glow, circle, ring, spark, star, flare, smoke flipbook, tiling noise, trail, shockwave, polygon, lightning) into Assets/VFX/_Textures, or list existing ones with their recipes.
